auth: none (public, no cookies, JSON only, no CORS headers)
notes: 202 is identical for new, duplicate, confirmed, unsubscribed and suppressed addresses (no enumeration oracle)
One double opt-in confirmation email is sent; nothing is confirmed or notified until the owner clicks
GET|POST /leads/confirm and GET|POST /leads/unsubscribe (token in the query) are for people and mail clients, not the CLI

Confirmation is scanner-safe (v2): GET /leads/confirm?token= only shows a page with one Confirm button and changes nothing; POST /leads/confirm?token= (form-encoded, empty body is fine) confirms and notifies once. Unknown or expired token: 404 neutral page on both verbs.
